task: Implement package-local test-file scopes and validate them under the parallel check runner.
observation: Detecting test scope by searching for any ancestor directory named tests misclassified package src files because runner worktrees themselves live below repository tests/. That made source declarations appear private and generated incorrect UNKNOWN_SYMBOL_OR_TYPE errors across unrelated package checks.
impact: The first full parallel run exposed 18 failures; anchoring tests/ to the nearest Moss.toml package root reduced the next run to four unrelated/stale expectations and the following run to only a JSON diagnostic envelope mismatch in the new fixture.

resolution.summary: Scope detection now considers only the package root's tests/ directory; cross-file helper fixtures and affected package checks pass.
